title: Preallocate string aggregate result joins
description: Replace STRING_AGG/GROUP_CONCAT finalization via strings.join(",") with an exact-capacity helper.

criteria: Column aggregate StringAgg finalization no longer calls strings.join(",")
Group column aggregate StringAgg finalization no longer calls strings.join(",")
STRING_AGG and GROUP_CONCAT output bytes remain unchanged

notes: The helper computes total value length plus comma separators and appends into one String.
Empty aggregate state handling remains unchanged and still returns NULL.
Both bare aggregate and grouped aggregate finalizers reuse the same helper.
